# Super-octo-bassoon skill

Use this skill when working in this repository.

## Operating principles

- Read the relevant files before making a change.
- Prefer the smallest fix that addresses the root cause.
- Keep edits focused and do not broaden scope without reason.
- Validate the change with the most relevant command available.
- Summarize the result clearly and include verification evidence.

## Workflow

1. Inspect the repository and target files.
2. Identify the exact root cause or requirement.
3. Make the minimal change needed.
4. Run the smallest relevant validation command.
5. Report what changed and how it was verified.

## Repository expectations

- Preserve a clean, understandable project structure.
- Keep documentation in sync when behavior or workflows change.
- Favor explicit, readable implementation over clever shortcuts.
- When tests are available, run the relevant subset instead of the entire suite.

## Output expectations

- Keep final responses concise and practical.
- Mention any commands run for verification.
- Call out uncertainty or follow-up needs if relevant.
